thread:
maria: Hey — spotted a weird billing spike for one customer. Streaming request + midstream tool_call fallback -> UI showed provisional 1.2k tokens then final 0.8k, but customer got charged ~2.0k. Anyone seen this pattern before?

josh: ugh. do we have a trace id? sounds like provisional events + retry got double-counted in ledger stitching.

maria: trace id: trace_2026_05_03_33. Logs show: initial stream -> toolcall -> client reconnect -> fallback to smaller model -> truncation. Router did 2 route handoffs.

lee: Thinking: we emit provisional token events on stream slices and then confirm on session close. If a reconnect creates a new session_id but we don't dedupe provisional entries by provenance, ledger stitches both.

ana: (typo) ana: can we add attempt_id to provisional events? then ledger can collapse by (session_id, attempt_id) on finalization.

maria: exact. right now only session_id + prefix captured. attempt_id would be cheap.

josh: also the console conflates provisional and confirmed in the waterfall. Ops saw the 1.2k provisional as final. We should change default view to show confirmed only, with an optional toggle for provisional.

console-ux: +1 on toggle. suggestion: show smoothed_charge = max(confirmed, provisional * 0.6) while finalizing to avoid panic. That UX could be opt-in.

lee: code idea: emit header on internal API: X-Redwood-Billing-Attempt: <uuid>

```
POST /v1/stream
Headers:
  X-Redwood-Session: sess_123
  X-Redwood-Billing-Attempt: att_456
```

Then provisional meter events include attempt id. Confirmed events reference attempt id when closing session. Ledger dedup: group by customer_id + session + attempt + token_range.

ana: retention question: provisional events currently TTL 7 days in the provisional queue. If we add attempt ids we probably need to keep them same window. Ops: can we handle extra cardinality?

lee: should be fine, low QPS per session. but we need to verify indexing cost. I'll run a cost sim.

josh: for immediate mitigation, can we change console to hide provisional by default and add note: "provisional numbers may change"? quick frontend patch.

maria: yes do that. Also add telemetry counters: streaming.provisional_tokens, streaming.confirmed_tokens, billing.dedupe_collapses. Query examples: "sum(streaming.provisional_tokens) by customer"

billing-bot: InvoiceEvent: provisional_charge emitted for customer cust_abc 2026-05-03T12:01:05Z (id evt_9876).

ana: opened ISSUE-4592 to track API header + ledger change + console default. assigning: lee (ledger), josh (console), maria (end-to-end test).

maria: thanks. small PR checklist: unit tests for dedupe logic, migration doc for ledger consumers, console feature flag. I'll draft RFC and link.

josh: @maria please cc billing/sre on RFC. we should also simulate reconnect storms in staging.

lee: I'll post a short repro script later today that simulates stream + toolcall + reconnects. includes attempt header.

maria: perfect. If we get agreement, patch timeline: patch1 (console hide provisional) -> patch2 (attempt header + ledger) -> patch3 (UI smoothing opt-in).

ana: sounds good. :thumbsup:
